**Pre-release (beta) — test it on your own servers; not yet production-certified.**

## Unth Recover v0.4.0-beta — Google Drive in the panel, Unth Recover Cloud agent, security fix

Everything from v0.3.0-beta (backups proven by a real isolated restore; offsite copies that are
encrypted, signed and downloaded again to prove them) plus:

### Security
- Built with **Go 1.26.11**: fixes **GO-2026-6859** (HTTP/1 server crash through a `MaxBytesReader`
  header race in `net/http`), which affected `unth serve`. Update if you expose the panel.

### New
- **Connect Google Drive in the panel** (Settings → Connections): Google's own sign-in and consent
  page; each user connects their own Drive; scope `drive.file` (unth sees only its own files);
  OAuth with PKCE; the token stays on the server (0600) and is revoked on Disconnect. New offsite
  type `gdrive` with native Drive support (resumable uploads) — no rclone needed. A new machine
  reuses the existing "Unth Recover Backups" folder.
- **`unth agent enroll|run|status`** — connects a server to **Unth Recover Cloud**
  (app.unthrecover.com) or another control plane: outbound HTTPS only, every request signed with
  the server's own Ed25519 key, jobs managed in the cloud with secrets encrypted to the server's
  key, local schedule keeps running during outages, Run now / Verify now, summaries only (never
  backup data). `unth-agent.service` in the `.deb` and `.rpm`. docs/AGENT.md.

### Tested
CI: PostgreSQL 12–17 integration matrix; Google Drive flow against a protocol-faithful fake of
Google OAuth + Drive (PKCE, refresh, revocation, resumable uploads) including fetch on an empty
machine + isolated restore → VERIFIED; agent protocol (signatures, replay, skew, tampering),
managed jobs end to end against a real database and the real cloud; `.deb` and `.rpm` install
tests; govulncheck, gosec, gitleaks. Details: docs/TEST_RESULTS.md.

### Known limitations
- Release binaries do not yet embed a project Google OAuth client: to connect Google Drive, set
  `UNTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `UNTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` (docs/OFFSITE.md) or use rclone
- Not yet tested by the project against real Google Cloud Storage, AWS or Google Drive accounts
- Linux only; the local data directory is not encrypted (offsite copies are)
- Restoring into your production database is manual (`pg_restore`); roles/privileges are not verified
- Docker socket access is root-equivalent

### Install
```bash
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unmadethings/unthrecover/main/scripts/install.sh
sudo sh install.sh --version v0.4.0-beta
```
Or: `sudo apt install ./unthrecover_0.4.0-beta_amd64.deb` · `sudo dnf install ./unthrecover_0.4.0-beta_amd64.rpm` ·
download `compose.yaml` and `docker compose up -d` · `docker pull ghcr.io/unmadethings/unthrecover:v0.4.0-beta`

Unth Recover Cloud: create an account at app.unthrecover.com, click **Add server** and run the
one-time command. Offsite setup: docs/OFFSITE.md · Agent: docs/AGENT.md
